qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology or Bioinformatics with 60% marks and 15 years experience in Toxicology/Analytical Toxicology, Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology or Bioinformatics with PhD in Toxicology related subject and 10 years experience (3 years PhD counted as experience)
qualification.details: Senior Consultant: Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Bioinformatics with at least 60% marks, along with 15 years of experience in the field of Toxicology/Analytical Toxicology after obtaining the Master's degree. OR Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Bioinformatics with a PhD in a subject related to Toxicology, along with 10 years of experience in the field of Toxicology/Analytical Toxicology. Three years of the PhD period shall be counted as experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026 is 09 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Consultant posts in AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Consultant post in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026. This recruitment offers a single opportunity for eligible candidates in the specified field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant posts is Email. Candidates are required to send their complete application along with all necessary documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Consultant post in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 is 50 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion to be eligible to apply for the position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Bioinformatics with 60% marks and 15 years of experience, OR a Master's degree in the same fields with a PhD in a Toxicology-related subject and 10 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for AIIMS Delhi Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories have a 'Nil' application fee, making it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Consultant position at AIIMS Delhi primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview round.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Senior Consultant post be located?
faq.answer: The Senior Consultant post will be located in New Delhi, Delhi. AIIMS Delhi is situated in New Delhi, making it the primary work location for the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Consultant position at AIIMS Delhi is Contractual. This indicates that the employment will be for a specific period as outlined in the official notification.
